## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, signing keys, or local credentials committed.
- [ ] No large scan data, DFRZ, PLY, GLB, APK, AAB, build output, or generated caches committed.
- [ ] No hidden network calls, analytics SDKs, or required cloud processing added.
- [ ] Docs, tests, or rationale updated for this change.
